text:
nightly-eval-bot: ALERT: 4 suites failed on nightly run (model: redwood-open-7b-int4-v2) — severity: medium. Summary: multiple prompt cohorts returning empty/very short completions. stack: eval/harness v2.3.1

eli: saw this first thing. a bunch of the instruction-style prompts returned "" or single token responses.

sarah: any change in quant pipeline last night?

nate: yes we pushed a small kernel tweak to int4 kernels ~02:12 UTC. could be related.

eli: initial failing suites: "instructional-basic", "accounting-snippets", "faq-compact", "structured-json-output" — most failures are short/blank output, not hallucinations.

jamie: severity medium ok. assigning owners: @sarah for kernel/quant, @nate for runtime/batching, @eli to reproduce and collect traces. :white_check_mark:

eli: repro steps I'm running now: ```bash
# run specific failing cohort locally
python eval/run_cohort.py --model redwood-open-7b-int4-v2 --cohort instructional-basic --seed 42 --limit 50 --log-level debug > /tmp/repro.log 2>&1
```

nightly-eval-bot: attached alert artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/alerts/4987659999/manifest.json (contains diffs and failure indices)

sarah: grabbing kernel CI logs and perf diffs. if it's kernel change, we should be able to toggle rollback flag for int4 kernels.

nate: checking runtime batching layer — we added an eager-kv-flush for small batches that may zero-length tokens for some prompt shapes. will test with flush disabled.

eli: quick eyeball of /tmp/repro.log shows a lot of immediate EOS tokens returned for many prompts (token id 50256). not truncated by length limit.

eli: sample from repro.log: ```
PROMPT id=12: "Summarize the user's instructions in one sentence."
RESPONSE: ""
TOKENS: [50256]
```

sarah: interesting — EOS as first token suggests model output distribution collapsed, could be quantization step or bug in logits dequant. committing to check dequant tables + scale factors.

jamie: can we quickly run the same cohort on redwood-open-7b-fp16 (hosted) to see if it's quant-only?

eli: yes doing that now, will compare pass/fail rates.

(nine minutes pass)

eli: quick result: fp16 run passes all 50. int4 run fails ~46/50. so this is quant/serving-related.

nate: I toggled eager-kv-flush off locally and re-ran int4: failures dropped to 10/50. so batching interaction definitely amplifies it but might not be sole cause.

sarah: pulled kernel telemetry — noticed change in per-head scale factors normalization in the new kernel. rolling back that change to test.

eli: while you do that, I'm generating a diffed token log for the failed cases and attaching to the alert bucket.

nightly-eval-bot: ARTIFACTS: s3://redwood-eval/alerts/4987659999/repro-logs.tar.gz, s3://redwood-eval/alerts/4987659999/token-diffs.csv

jamie: plan for next 2 hours: 1) Sarah: kernel rollback & test int4 baseline. 2) Nate: runtime patch to disable eager-kv-flush on small cohorts + test. 3) Eli: collect failing prompt list and run ablation to see which prompt templates trigger EOS.

eli: I'll also produce minimal reproducer snippet for kernels folks (short prompt + single-step sampling) so they can iterate fast.

sarah: if rollback fixes, we'll dequeue the alert. if it reduces but not eliminate, prep a canary rollback for tonight and notify infra to hold dedicated capacity.

nate: tagging infra in follow-up if canary needed.

jamie: thanks team. update here when you have kernel test results or a clear mitigation. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eli: leaving notes in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/EVAL-3421 — added initial repro, failing indices, owners.

sarah: kernel rollback run complete — int4 pass 50/50 on my machine. pushing candidate revert PR.

nate: runtime change also lowers failures further in staging. combined revert + runtime disable brings to 0/50 in quick run.

eli: awesome. marking alert resolved for now. follow-ups: - stress run on bigger cohorts overnight - add unit test covering EOS-as-first-token regression - improve nightly alert to include quantization kernel version.

jamie: great triage. closing loop: severity->resolved, owners: sarah/nate/eli. will file postmortem if it recurs. :v:
